price_why: A leather worker gets a fully built slide-by-slide carousel with caption, Reel and Pin, plus a holiday-timed 6-week plan and shipping cutoff. They'd pay for that. The platform-changes section is padding they could skip, and weeks 2-6 still need real work, so it isn't worth $49.
one_line: A research-backed brief that picks one fully built beginner carousel (slanted back stitches) and repurposes it as a Trial Reel and Pin. It adds a holiday-timed 6-week plan for both audiences.
strongest: The slant-fix carousel is specific to this creator and audience: a real recurring beginner problem, nine concrete slides, a caption, hashtags, and a Reel and Pinterest repurpose from one shoot.
weakest: The suggested caption has the creator say it was 'the #1 question I got when I started' and that every piece is checked on both faces, which invents history and claims they must make true. Weeks 2-6 are only sketched, and a heavy cadence (2-3 IG posts a week plus a daily Pin) plus a long platform-updates section load a solo garage maker.
